edges.label: F1 status, note, submit; retry; refresh; click or /security [keyboard, local; Confidential]
F2 POST the command: record key, expected version, values, Idempotency-Key; GET the outcome by key; GET the Security page [HTTPS, session cookie; Confidential]
F3 the same, with a request id [HTTP on the host, session cookie; Confidential]
F4 session, roles, membership epoch [TLS, role workspace; Restricted]
F5 record schema and permitted transitions of the pinned publication [TLS, role workspace; Internal]
F6 command: principal scope, work id, app revision, schema id, record key, expected version, values, key, epoch [in process, principal and epoch; Confidential]
F7 one transaction: outcome by key, record FOR UPDATE, membership FOR SHARE, work revision, record revision, outcome, audit [TLS, role data; Confidential]
F8 stored outcome on a replay; current version on a conflict [TLS, role data; Confidential]
F9 committed version; or the stored outcome; or conflict with an authorized recovery view [in process; Confidential]
F10 outcome, recovery view, the Security page with its view state; 404 outside the organization [HTTP on the host, session; Confidential]
F11 the same, no-store; a response below the current epoch is dropped on arrival [HTTPS, session; Confidential]
F12 Chrome's sanitised export of the take: status codes, outcomes, receipts, epochs as received [file export from each actor's profile, by the operator; Confidential]
F13 audit events, job states, build digest: the operator views [HTTPS, operator session, just in time; Internal]

boundaries.label: The host's network: the edge, the one process, PostgreSQL
Role data: a database role, not a hop (D1); the only writer of records
